base_cv.v2_status: STRUCTURAL (empirically validated per Fix #1 in v2)
base_cv._v2_mechanism_C4_empirical_test: Per X v1 §4 stress-test predicted CV ~4.92 with bar3 50% cut (X's exact recipe: R1=12, R2=8, R3=32). v2 RAN that recipe end-to-end via analytic_profile. Result: CV = 6.086 (vs v1's 6.118 = same mode). Mechanism C-4 moved CV by only -0.03 — well within numerical noise. X's naive Bernoulli model OVERESTIMATED CV reduction by a factor of ~40×. The engine variance is dominated by cherry-anywhere 1× mass (12.7% P) and wild_pure 200× tail (E[X²] contribution 200²×P_wild ~ 50), NOT by bar3 (20² × 0.14% = 0.56). Cutting bar3 doesn't move CV. Per memory feedback_dont_lower_floor_when_blocked.md: 4 mechanism categories systematically tested (a) cut high-multiplier (high7/wild_pure breach §2 brand visibility + §7), (b) lift low-multiplier (cherry P → 25%+ breaches §8 + hit band), (c) bar3 cut (this v2 attempt — empirically demonstrated does NOT help CV), (d) architecture upgrade (would require paytable change or virtual reel mapping — out of scope this session). All in-architecture mechanisms exhausted; STRUCTURAL claim is now rigorous, not premature.
base_cv._structural_explanation: M15 paytable cherry-anywhere + low-vol band + high-multiplier tail (200×/30×/20×) are JOINTLY structurally incompatible with [3,5] CV band given current strip + paytable architecture. Reaching CV ≤5 would require EITHER (a) paytable change (smaller top jackpot, e.g. 100× instead of 200×, OR add mid-multiplier ladders 50×/75× to spread variance), OR (b) drop §8 cherry-anywhere brand requirement, OR (c) accept hit_rate >18% with cherry1 P ~25%+. All require user adjudication. v1 STRUCTURAL flag retained in v2 with stronger empirical foundation.
base_cv._recommended_user_decision: Adjudicate one of: (A) relax base CV band to [4.5, 7] (cherry-anywhere modern hybrid achievable range), (B) accept paytable change (out of v1.1 brief scope), (C) accept v7-like CV ~5.8 as design intent for M15 specifically.
